text.text_excerpt: Beautiful hotel from the outside, this is what I think of when thinking of New Orleans. The inside is nice and small with very nice staff. There is a pool out back that is covered by walls, very cool. The only thing I did not like was the echoing throughout the hotel. If there was an obnoxious loud person in any area of the hotel, you can be sure to hear it from wherever you are within the hotel. I lost a lot of sleep because of it. However, It is a very lovely hotel and I'm glad I stayed here.

Built in 1806 and opened as a hotel in 1964, Hotel St. Helene is a low-frills easy access boutique inn just a block away from Jackson Square. I've actually been waiting a long time to write this review. I've stayed here multiple times over the course of four years and there is a lot to be praised, but some things were just left to be desired. First off, the front desk staff has always been fabulous. They are always greeting you and seeing you out of the door and since this hotel only has 16 rooms, you kind of develop a friendship with some of the staff, which I find adds to the experience. When booking, there are 3 different types of rooms. Rooms with the front balcony facing Rue Chartres...

Last year I visited this hotel for the first time and this year I am returning. I have to say I absolutely love this hotel. The staff is a dream always so helpful and nice. I was even given a discount for returning which was a plus. We stayed 4 nights and we had no problems. Rooms are clean and bigger then most in the french quarter, they have a separate searing area with a white leather couch. The hotels location is excellent as well. I have no complaints at all. I will be returning here everytime I visit New Orleans.
